summary: Mistral introduced Robostral Navigate, an 8B parameter in-house model that lets robots autonomously navigate using only a single RGB camera, reporting 76.6% success on the R2R-CE unseen validation benchmark.

practices.reason: A newly released embodied-navigation model achieves stated state-of-the-art benchmark results using only a single camera, relevant to teams building robotics or embodied agents but not to general LLM application teams.
practices.quote: achieves 76.6% on R2R-CE (Room-to-Room in Continuous Environments) validation unseen, the benchmark for following instructions in environments held out of training

practices.reason: The model is measured against the standard R2R-CE suite of metrics, which a team building navigation systems could adopt to benchmark its own models.
practices.quote: Success Rate Oracle Success Rate Success weighted by path length Navigation Error

practices.reason: Describes a concrete pointing-based control scheme with a fallback to metric displacement commands, a design pattern a robotics engineering team could implement and evaluate.
practices.quote: Robostral Navigate predicts where the robot should move next via pointing : it infers the image coordinates of the target location in the robot's current camera view, together with the desired orientation upon arrival.
